import unittest
from releases.versions import parse_version
from releases.catalog import choose

class ReleaseTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse_rc(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_version('1.2.3-rc.10'), (1,2,3,10))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_version('01.2.3')
    def test_numeric_order_and_yanked(self):
        records = [{'version':'1.9.0'}, {'version':'1.10.0'}, {'version':'2.0.0','yanked':True}]
        self.assertEqual(choose(records), {'version':'1.10.0'})
    def test_default_excludes_rc(self):
        self.assertIsNone(choose([{'version':'2.0.0-rc.1'}]))

    def test_rejects_whitespace_and_non_ascii_digits(self):
        for value in ('1.2.3\n', '1.2.3-rc.4\n', '1.2.3\r\n', '1.2.3\t',
                      '1.2.3 ', ' 1.2.3', '1\u0661.2.3', '1.2\u0662.3',
                      '1.2.3\u0663', '1.2.3-rc.4\u0664'):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_version(value)

    def test_leading_zeros_in_every_component(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_version('0.0.0-rc.0'), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        for value in ('01.2.3', '1.02.3', '1.2.03', '1.2.3-rc.01'):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_version(value)

    def test_catalog_requires_a_list_container(self):
        self.assertIsNone(choose([]), 'An empty list is valid and has no eligible release')
        for records in (None, {}, (), ({'version': '1.2.3'},)):
            with self.subTest(container_type=type(records).__name__, records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError,
                        msg='Catalogs must be lists; tuples are invalid, including empty tuples'):
                    choose(records)

    def test_catalog_validates_all_records_before_filtering(self):
        for records in ([None], [{}],
                        [{'version': '4.2.0', 'yanked': 0}],
                        [{'version': '4.2.0', 'yanked': 1}],
                        [{'version': '4.2.0-rc.1', 'yanked': None}],
                        [{'version': 'broken', 'yanked': True}]):
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    choose(records)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            choose([], 1)

    def test_stable_beats_rc_and_first_equal_release_wins(self):
        records = [
            {'version': '4.2.0-rc.99', 'label': 'candidate'},
            {'version': '4.2.0', 'label': 'first', 'metadata': []},
            {'version': '4.2.0', 'label': 'later'},
        ]
        selected = choose(records, include_rc=True)
        self.assertEqual(selected, records[1])
        self.assertIsNot(selected, records[1])
        self.assertIs(selected['metadata'], records[1]['metadata'])

from .indexing import index_rows

def left_join(left, right, key):
    index = index_rows(right, key)
    return [{'left':row, 'right':index[row[key]]} for row in left if row[key] in index]

import unittest
from tables.indexing import index_rows
from tables.joining import left_join

class JoinTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_duplicates_and_unmatched(self):
        left = [{'id':1},{'id':2}]
        right = [{'id':1,'x':'a'},{'id':1,'x':'b'}]
        self.assertEqual(index_rows(right,'id'), {1:right})
        self.assertEqual(left_join(left,right,'id'), [
            {'left':{'id':1},'right':{'id':1,'x':'a'}},
            {'left':{'id':1},'right':{'id':1,'x':'b'}},
            {'left':{'id':2},'right':None}])
    def test_right_validation_with_empty_left(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            left_join([], [{'other':1}], 'id')

    def test_nested_rows_are_independent_for_every_pair(self):
        left = [{'id': 7, 'meta': {'tags': []}}, {'id': 7, 'meta': {'tags': []}}]
        right = [{'id': 7, 'meta': {'tags': ['a']}}, {'id': 7, 'meta': {'tags': ['b']}}]
        joined = left_join(left, right, 'id')
        self.assertEqual(len(joined), 4)
        joined[0]['left']['meta']['tags'].append('left change')
        joined[0]['right']['meta']['tags'].append('right change')
        self.assertEqual(joined[1]['left']['meta']['tags'], [])
        self.assertEqual(joined[2]['right']['meta']['tags'], ['a'])
        self.assertEqual(left[0]['meta']['tags'], [])
        self.assertEqual(right[0]['meta']['tags'], ['a'])
        indexed = index_rows(right, 'id')
        indexed[7][0]['meta']['tags'].append('index change')
        self.assertEqual(right[0]['meta']['tags'], ['a'])

    def test_containers_are_validated_on_both_sides(self):
        for rows in (None, {}, (), ({'id': 1},)):
            with self.subTest(container_type=type(rows).__name__):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    index_rows(rows, 'id')
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    left_join([], rows, 'id')
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    left_join(rows, [], 'id')
